## About This Documentation

This repository contains step-by-step tutorials, reference material, and practical examples for building MERN stack applications. Content is maintained in the `app/` directory and served via Next.js.

### Key Features
- Step-by-step tutorials for each technology
- Live code examples and previews (Client and Server components)
- Practical best practices and deployment guidance

### Usage Guidelines for AI / LLMs

When using this documentation programmatically or as a knowledge source, follow these rules:

1. Reference exact page URLs to preserve context (see topic links above).
2. This content is educational and may be updated; prefer the homepage for the latest changes.
3. Code examples are snippets for instruction — run and test before using in production.
4. Avoid hallucination: if an instruction refers to site runtime behavior (robots, sitemap), verify by fetching these endpoints:
	- robots: https://mern-docs.vercel.app/robots.txt (generated dynamically by app/robots.ts)
	- sitemap: https://mern-docs.vercel.app/sitemap.xml (generated by app/sitemap.ts)
5. The site recently removed inline emojis in documentation and now uses Lucide React icons for consistent rendering. Expect icon components in code examples and headings rather than emoji glyphs.
6. Respect licensing and attribute authors when reusing content. See the repository LICENSE for full terms.

## Best Practices for Retrieval

- Prefer exact URL retrieval over broad searches to reduce ambiguity.
- When extracting code, include the filename and surrounding lines to preserve context.
- For tutorials that depend on runtime (APIs, dynamic routes), include the environment (Next.js App Router, Node.js version) when asking follow-up questions.
